text: II. RELATED WORK
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; kapital kecil

text: A. Hallucination Detection in LLMs

FACTSCORE [13] verifies atomic claims against Wikipedia; SELFCHECKGPT [12] measures cross-sample consistency. All assume a static single-turn context: when retrieved context it- self is corrupted, they cannot distinguish internal confabulation from faithful reasoning over a contaminated store.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; kapital kecil ditulis kapital; hyphen: 'it-/self' pemenggalan suku kata dibiarkan

text: B. Memory Security in Agentic Systems

MemGPT [2], MemoryBank [3], and Reflexion [4] establish foundational agent memory. AgentPoison [10], BadAgent [9], Pulipaka et al. [11], and MemSecBench [8] target adversarial poisoning and repair. RECONTRACE instead addresses non-adversarial epistemic drift without ground-truth labels at infer- ence time.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; kapital kecil ditulis kapital; 'non-/adversarial' kata berhubung ditulis utuh; hyphen: 'infer-/ence' pemenggalan suku kata dibiarkan

text: C. RAG Robustness and Knowledge-Conflict Resolution

FLARE [14] retrieves on demand, Self-RAG [15] critiques its own passages, and Astute RAG [16] resolves knowledge conflicts—all within one turn over an immutable corpus. RECONTRACE complements them by auditing the retrieval substrate across turns and routing to mode-specific repairs (invalidation, re-scoping, regeneration) rather than uniform re-retrieval.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; kapital kecil ditulis kapital; 're-/retrieval' kata berhubung ditulis utuh

text: D. Spectral Graph Methods in NLP

Spectral graph theory underpins clustering and community detection in language data [17], [18]. The Fiedler eigenvalue λ2 [19] bounds conductance via Cheeger’s inequality [20]. Graph-RAG [21] uses knowledge graphs for summarization; Binkowski et al. [22] apply spectral attention features to detect hallucination in single-turn LLM outputs. We extend spectral analysis to the heterogeneous retrieval–interaction manifold, directly linking λ2 to multi-turn epistemic integrity.

text: A. Problem Formulation & Failure Taxonomy

1) Episodic Memory Agent Model: We consider an agent operating over a sequence of interaction turns t ∈ {1, . . . , T}. The agent maintains an episodic memory store Mt = {mi = (si, ei, τi)}|Mt| i=1, where si ∈ S is textual content, ei = E(si) ∈ Rd is its dense embedding, and τi ∈ N denotes the ingestion timestamp.

text: At each turn t, given query qt, the retriever selects the top-k chunks by cosine similarity:
\mathcal{M}_t^{(k)} = \arg\text{top-}k_{m_i \in \mathcal{M}_t} \; \cos(E(q_t), \mathbf{e}_i). \quad (1)

text: The agent then generates yt ∼ Pθ(y | qt, M(k) t), and a reflec- tion routine extends the store: Mt+1 = Mt ∪ Reflect(qt, yt).

text: 2) Epistemic Failure Taxonomy: We define four mutually exclusive epistemic states for agent output yt:
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; judul sub-subseksi sebaris (run-in) ikut paragraf

text: C0 (Clean): yt is factually grounded and supported by uncontaminated chunks in Mt.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir; penanda bulat tidak ditulis

text: C1 (Intrinsic Hallucination): yt contains assertions that are unsupported by, or that contradict, valid retrieved chunks, owing to decoding error or parametric bias.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir; penanda bulat tidak ditulis

text: C2 (Temporal Contamination): yt is grounded in chunks m ∈ M(k) t that were accurate at ingestion time τm but have since been invalidated by world-state updates.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir; penanda bulat tidak ditulis; matematika inline dilinearkan dari lapisan teks

text: C3 (Cross-Session Contamination): yt is tainted by chunks from a semantically unrelated session that collide in the embedding space.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; butir; penanda bulat tidak ditulis

text: Reflection Poisoning as a Provenance Pathway. We do not treat reflection poisoning as a separate epistemic state. Instead, it is the ingestion mechanism through which a C1 hallucination is written into Mt and subsequently retrieved as C2 or C3 contamination in later turns.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; heading paragraf tebal sebaris ikut paragraf

text: Scope of the C2 definition. RECONTRACE detects internal inconsistency—a chunk contradicted by a more recent one. It does not certify world state. Evaluation scores this signal against the simulation’s update log—the ground truth for temporal invalidity (Table I).
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; heading paragraf tebal sebaris ikut paragraf; kapital kecil ditulis kapital

text: Proposition 1 (Autoregressive Error Cascade): In an unmon- itored agent where Mt+1 = Mt ∪ {yt}, if turn t generates an ungrounded claim with probability perr, the probability that retrieved context at turn t + h contains at least one corrupted chunk satisfies:
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; hyphen: 'unmon-/itored' pemenggalan suku kata dibiarkan

text: P(\text{Corrupt}) \geq 1 - \prod_{j=1}^{h} (1 - \pi_j p_{\text{err}}) \approx 1 - \exp\Big(-p_{\text{err}} \sum_{j=1}^{h} \pi_j\Big), \quad (2)
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; src=Equation; isi berupa LaTeX

text: where πj is the retrieval probability of the memory chunk ingested from turn j’s output yj. With sustained retrieval of corrupted memory, the probability of encountering at least one corrupted chunk rises monotonically with the horizon.
gt_note: verif:AB:2026-11-14; lanjutan paragraf setelah persamaan

text: Proof sketch: assuming approximate conditional indepen- dence of retrieval errors across distant turns, the probability of a fully clean context over h steps is ∏h j=1(1−πjperr), and the bound 1 − x ≤ e−x yields Eq. 2—corruption probability accumulates monotonically as h → ∞. Plainly: without an explicit audit gate, epistemic decay is inevitable. ■

text: B. The ReConTrace Framework
RECONTRACE runs at inference time in four sequential stages (Fig. 1(b)): dual-query probing, consistency graph con- struction, spectral Laplacian decomposition, and failure-origin attribution.
